proposed_english: the Dry one and the Moist one
rationale: Cosmological dyad opening this kephalaion. ⲡⲡⲉⲧϣⲟⲩⲱⲩ already in glossary as 'the Dry one'; ⲡⲡⲉⲧⲁⲅⲃⲉ is a Lyc. spelling variant of ⲡⲉⲧⲁⲇⲃⲉ 'the moist one' (in glossary). Together they are identified with the Calling-and-Hearing dyad — direct elemental-cosmological correspondence.
Recurs in lines 3 and 7. Tentatively interpreted as 'powers/power' (cf. ⲇⲩⲛⲁⲙⲓⲥ or Lyc. ⲟⲁⲙ 'power'). The form is unusual — possibly a scribal compression. Confidence low; flag for parallels.
Possibly Coptic ⲉⲃⲥⲱ 'grass, fodder' or related agricultural term. Context: 'the X and the herbage which she crushes' in the soul-in-fruits passage. Confidence moderate.
Reduplicated form of ⲡⲧⲱⲧ 'fall, knock down' giving iterative 'pound.' Fits agricultural sequence of crushing seeds and fruits.
Probable Lyc. variant of ⲧϩⲉ 'manner, fashion' (cf. accumulated ⲧⲛⲟ/ⲡⲛⲟ 'the manner'). Used here introducing analogy: 'the manner also in which they dry up...'
Tentatively from Greek πληγή 'blow' verbalized with ⲣ̄-. Fits the violent-treatment sequence in the soul-in-fruits imagery.
Reduplicated form of unclear stem; possibly ⲗⲱⲗⲉϩ 'writhe, twist' or ⲣⲁⲩⲣⲉϩ. Action verb in soul-affliction context.
ⲁⲏ = Lyc. ϩⲁⲏ 'end, last' (cf. ⲡⲓⲃⲱⲗⲟⲥ ⲛ̄ⲍⲁⲉ in glossary). With demonstrative ⲡⲉⲓ- = 'this end.'
ⲧⲕⲉ- ('the other') + ⲧⲁⲓⲉ ('kind, category,' in glossary). Standard 'the other kind/category.'
Privative ⲛ̄ⲁⲧ- + ⲡⲧⲱⲛⲉ (variant of ⲡⲱⲱⲛⲉ 'change, move'). Modifier of the unified eschatological Soul: 'unchanging, unmoving.'
The primordial substance of the Soul from which it was sent forth into the cosmic battle. Standard Manichaean cosmogonic term: ⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ 'substance' (in glossary) + ϣⲁⲣⲡ 'first.'
Standard title for Mani in the Kephalaia. Greek ἀπόστολος. Capitalized as the speaker-figure throughout the work.
